featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the worst shops to buy anything from. The shopkeeper provides no after-sales service or warranties, even though he messed up the restringing of my squash rackets which costed me 2398/- for two rackets. Another store confirmed that the racket string tension was not at the requested 26lbs. When I asked this shopkeeper to refit it, he argued and refused to provide any after-sales service, instead expecting me to pay the full price of the string if I want to refit. Unfortunately, I'm not in India to address this issue directly, but I'm sharing my experience to warn other sports enthusiasts. Beware, as he is good at scamming people.

Replying to owners response
As a sports enthusiast, I understand that squash can't be played every day. Your claim that I played every day is amusing, especially since I explicitly mentioned that I played only once that week. During that session, I and my friend noticed the strings for both racquets were tied at a lower tension than what was asked for and with poor knots, so indeed its your responsibility to replace them at your OWN COST. If you believe I'm misleading people, I wish good luck to those who trust your products. However, I will never recommend anyone to buy from you. Sellers like you try to cover up by providing false responses. I have nothing to gain here, just offering honest advice to others as a consumer.

Overall, it was a very pleasant shopping experience at Decathlon Malad. A big thank you to Sai, Noel, and the entire Waterworks team for their excellent service and support. Experiences like this make customers want to come back again.
